notes: The Japan models A1779 and A1785 contain FeliCa.

gaps: The teardown gives the iPhone 7 display as 4.7-inch IPS, 1334 x 750, which the parts listing does not state.
method: Apple's model table lists the iPhone 7 model numbers on the back cover as A1660, A1778 and A1779 (Japan).
IFixit's teardown names A1779 once (stamped on the rear case) and lists the chips found in its unit, including 32 GB flash (the page lists 32, 128 or 256 GB models).
IFixit's A1779 Japan parts index lists the display, battery, cameras, speakers, vibrator and Lightning connector assembly.

comps.spec: Apple A10 Fusion APL1W24 SoC; the page says it has an embedded M10 motion coprocessor
In the teardown unit: Samsung 2 GB LPDDR4 RAM, marking K3RG1G10CM-YGCH; SK Hynix H23QEG8VG2ACS 32 GB Flash (the page lists 32, 128 or 256 GB models)
Qualcomm MDM9645M LTE Cat. 12 modem; Murata 339S00199 Wi-Fi/Bluetooth module
Apple/Dialog Semiconductor 338S00225 power management IC; Qualcomm PMD9645 power management IC; Texas Instruments TPS65730A0P power management IC
Invensense accelerometer; Bosch Sensortec BMP280 barometric pressure sensor
Two microphones included with the Lightning connector assembly (iPhone 7 Lightning Connector Assembly listing)
Lightning connector assembly, Part #821-00270-08, with flex cable and two microphones; Lightning port gasket and bezel also listed
1960 mAh replacement battery listed for the iPhone 7 (the page says it is not for the iPhone 7 Plus)
12 MP main rear camera (iPhone 7 Rear Camera listing)
LCD and digitizer assembly, listed as iPhone 7 LCD and Digitizer, a replacement for a scratched or cracked front glass panel or malfunctioning display
iPhone 7 Loudspeaker, and an earpiece speaker listed for the iPhone 7 among other models
iPhone 7 Vibrator, described on the page as a linear oscillating vibrator
Front camera and sensor cable, Part #821-00504-A; the listing says it includes a proximity sensor
Non-mechanical Touch ID home button, described in the teardown as a solid state mini touch sensor
Qualcomm WTR4905 multimode LTE transceiver
Qualcomm WTR3925 RF transceiver
Skyworks SKY78100-20 power amplifier module
Avago AFEM-8065 power amplifier module
Avago AFEM-8055 power amplifier module
Skyworks SKY13702-20 diversity receive module
Skyworks SKY13703-21 diversity receive module
NXP PN67V NFC controller with secure element
Apple/Cirrus Logic 338S00105 audio codec
Cirrus Logic 338S00220 audio amplifier, two of them
iPhone 7 Top Right Antenna, listed for A1779 Japan
